title: Rip'd
lines: Both balls feature the new Rip’D core, which is a combination of the successful Scandal and Gauntlet core shapes.
With Hammer’s patent-pending carbon fiber infused coverstock and outer core.
Hammer Tough N Tacky is recommended to keep the Rip'D performing at its best.
FACTORY FINISH 500/1000 Abralon Polished with Powerhouse Factory Finish Polish
BEST LANE CONDITION Medium to Heavy Oil
